# Grow with Samah

> Personal portfolio of Samah — a freelance Digital Marketing Strategist helping brands grow with SEO, content marketing, Google Ads, social media, and performance-driven marketing systems.

Canonical website: https://growwithsamah.com

## About

Samah (Grow with Samah) is a freelance Digital Marketing Strategist and Marketing Consultant. The site presents her positioning, services, selected case studies, working process, and a free consultation booking flow.

Primary expertise includes Digital Marketing Strategy, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Content Marketing, Google Ads / PPC, Performance Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Email Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Marketing Analytics, Lead Generation, and Brand Strategy.

## Intended audience

- Founders and marketing leads looking to hire a Digital Marketing Strategist or SEO Consultant
- Service businesses and brands seeking measurable digital growth
- Teams evaluating SEO, content, paid media, or full-funnel marketing support

## Core services

Service offerings are listed on the homepage Services section and managed in the live portfolio CMS. Typical engagements cover:

- SEO / Technical SEO / Website SEO / Local SEO
- Content strategy and content marketing
- Google Ads and performance marketing
- Social media marketing
- Email marketing and lead generation
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- Marketing analytics and growth strategy
